SPINR RIDER v3 — App Store, iPhone 6.7" · 1290 × 2796

Layout follows the store convention used by Uber, Lyft, DoorDash and
Duolingo: centered headline, straight-on device, floating feature chips.
Frame 1 is the solid brand-red hero; frames 2–5 sit on warm paper.
Upload in this order — search results show only the first 2–3.

CHIP RULES (learned the hard way)
Each floating chip carries a fact that is NOT already on the screen
beside it, and is positioned over a quiet zone — never over a price,
plate, or button. If you move one, check what it covers.

SAMPLE DATA — swap before submitting.
Fares ($22.99 and its line items are internally consistent), Saskatoon
addresses, "Sam R.", plate 4WX 812, Visa 4242, ratings, driver counts.
Vehicle tiers (Standard / XL / Accessible) are placeholders — real ones
are admin-managed vehicle_types rows.

STILL TO DO
• Google Play set at 1080 × 1920 (Play rejects taller than 9:16).
• Spinr Driver listing — separate set, same system.
Both are quick now that _build.py exists.
